_comment: --reload was removed from 'backend' deliberately. This platform's whole purpose is
long-running background jobs that survive disconnects, and uvicorn's reloader tears the
process down on ANY .py save — killing whatever job is in flight. That destroyed real
in-progress work three separate times in one session, and worse, the shutdown blocks on
open SSE streams ('Waiting for connections to close'), leaving the server wedged rather
than cleanly restarted. Jobs checkpoint to disk and resume, so nothing is lost forever,
but a dev convenience that routinely interrupts the product's core capability is a bad
trade. Use 'backend-reload' below when iterating on backend code with no job running.
See jobs.py resume() for how an interrupted job is picked back up.
configurations.name: backend-reload
